title: SpaceSMP Modpack
description: A Create X AdAstra modpack with vannila+ content
body:
# Vanilla+ Create: Ad Astra

Experience Minecraft reimagined with a carefully curated Vanilla+ modpack that expands every aspect of the game without losing its familiar charm. From stunning new landscapes and diverse biomes to advanced engineering, vehicles, space travel, and dangerous new creatures, every addition is designed to feel like a natural extension of vanilla Minecraft.

Begin your journey in a world filled with enhanced terrain generation, breathtaking vistas, and unique biomes. Discover new structures, encounter challenging mobs, and gather resources to fuel your growing ambitions.

Master the power of Create to build intricate factories, automated farms, railways, and mechanical contraptions. Travel the world with a variety of vehicles, connect distant settlements, and establish thriving industrial hubs.

When the Overworld is no longer enough, take your technology to the next level with Ad Astra. Construct rockets, explore the Moon and beyond, establish extraterrestrial colonies, and uncover valuable resources across the Solar System.

### Features

* ⚙️ Create-powered engineering and automation
* 🚀 Space exploration with Ad Astra
* 🌎 Enhanced world generation and realistic terrain
* 🌲 Beautiful new biomes and ecosystems
* 🚗 Vehicles for faster and more immersive travel
* 👾 New mobs, creatures, and challenges
* 🏛️ Additional structures and points of interest
* 🏠 Expanded building possibilities and decoration
* 🎒 Quality-of-life improvements and performance enhancements
* 🤝 Balanced progression that stays true to Minecraft's spirit

Whether you enjoy building massive factories, exploring uncharted wilderness, creating transportation networks, or reaching the stars, Vanilla+ Create: Ad Astra offers a complete adventure that evolves from survival to industry—and from industry to space.

**Build. Explore. Automate. Colonize the Stars.**
